<style>
/* Layout: full-bleed hero (light + charcoal dark mode) — greeting + flip-calendar skills top-left, card bottom-left, cut-out portrait anchored right on the status hairline. */
:root{
  --background:#E8E4E0; --foreground:#1A1818; --ink:#1A1818;
  --muted:#857878; --subtle:#B5A8A8; --line:#D5CDCA;
  --surface:#DED8D4; --surface-2:#D3CBC8;
  --accent:#6B5C5C; --accent-from:#C4B0B0; --accent-to:#6B5C5C;
  --hero-from:#EEEAE6; --hero-mid:#E8E4E0; --hero-to:#D8CDCA;
  --radius-pill:9999px; --radius-card:2rem; --radius-card-sm:1.25rem; --radius-control:.875rem;
  --text-watermark:13rem; --container-shell:88rem;
  --font:'Onest',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --e-line:cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1);
  --e-spring:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
  --e-soft:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  --e-snap:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  --bar-h:3.5rem;
  --gut-lg:5.5rem;   /* one side margin for nav, headline, chips and portrait */
  /* mode-dependent tokens (light) */
  --fg-rgb:26,24,24;
  --chip-bg:rgba(242,238,235,.5); --chip-bg-h:rgba(242,238,235,.85); --chip-line:rgba(196,176,176,.45);
  --btn-bg:#1A1818; --btn-fg:#E8E4E0; --btn-badge-bg:#E8E4E0; --btn-badge-fg:#1A1818;
  --outline-h:rgba(196,176,176,.18);
  --vig:rgba(240,236,232,.35);
  --panel:#F0ECE9; --field:rgba(196,176,176,.12); --scrim:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.3);
  --cord-shadow:.2;
  color-scheme:light;
}
/* dark mode: charcoal, a step above pure black */
html[data-mode="dark"]{
  --background:#1A1818; --foreground:#E8E4E0; --fg-rgb:232,228,224;
  --line:rgba(196,176,176,.16); --surface:#252121; --surface-2:#302A2A;
  --chip-bg:rgba(196,176,176,.06); --chip-bg-h:rgba(196,176,176,.12); --chip-line:rgba(196,176,176,.16);
  --btn-bg:#E8E4E0; --btn-fg:#1A1818; --btn-badge-bg:#1A1818; --btn-badge-fg:#E8E4E0;
  --outline-h:rgba(196,176,176,.08);
  --vig:rgba(0,0,0,.22);
  --panel:#221F1F; --field:rgba(196,176,176,.06); --scrim:rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  --cord-shadow:.55;
  color-scheme:dark;
}
/* mode switch: one GPU crossfade of the whole page (View Transitions) instead of
   hundreds of per-element colour transitions running out of step */
::view-transition-old(root),::view-transition-new(root){animation-duration:.5s;animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.cord{view-transition-name:cord}
#cal{view-transition-name:cal}
::view-transition-old(cal){display:none}
::view-transition-new(cal){animation:none}
::view-transition-old(cord){display:none}
::view-transition-new(cord){animation:none}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{overscroll-behavior-y:none;scrollbar-width:none;font-size:16px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;background:#1A1818;overflow-x:clip}
html[data-mode="dark"]{background:#0F0E0E}
html::-webkit-scrollbar,body::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;width:0;height:0}
body{background:var(--background);color:var(--foreground);font-family:var(--font);overflow-x:clip}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer}
ul{list-style:none}
img{display:block;max-width:none}
svg{display:block;width:1em;height:1em;flex:none}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.tnum{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* ---------- adaptive rem grid ---------- */
@media (max-width:1920px){html{font-size:.833333vw}}
@media (max-width:1440px){html{font-size:1.111111vw}}
@media (max-width:1024px){html{font-size:1.5625vw}}
@media (max-width:640px){html{font-size:4.444444vw}}

.shell{max-width:var(--container-shell);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:1.25rem;width:100%}
@media (min-width:640px){.shell{padding-inline:2rem}}
@media (min-width:1024px){.shell{padding-inline:var(--gut-lg)}}

/* ---------- skip link ---------- */
.skip{position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:auto}
.skip:focus{position:fixed;left:1rem;top:1rem;z-index:60;min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:var(--radius-control);background:var(--ink);padding:.5rem 1rem;font-size:.875rem;color:#fff}

/* ---------- reveal system (plays once body.ready is set) ---------- */
.rv{opacity:0;transform:var(--from,translateY(10px));transition:opacity .8s var(--ease,var(--e-soft)) var(--d,0ms),transform .8s var(--ease,var(--e-soft)) var(--d,0ms)}
body.ready .rv{opacity:var(--to-o,1);transform:none}
.line{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:.06em;margin-bottom:-.06em}
.line>span{display:block;transform:translateY(100%);opacity:0;transition:transform .9s var(--e-line) var(--d,0ms),opacity .9s var(--e-line) var(--d,0ms)}
body.ready .line>span{transform:none;opacity:1}

/* ---------- loader: the doors' colours stack up, one per discipline, then slides away to open the page ---------- */
.loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:120;overflow:hidden;color:#E8E4E0;--p:0;font-family:'Onest',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif}
.ld__bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(38% 55% at 0% 72%,rgba(164,85,44,.26),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(40% 58% at 100% 70%,rgba(196,176,176,.16),transparent 72%),
  radial-gradient(70% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(107,92,92,.3),transparent 70%),#0D0C0C;transition:transform .85s cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1)}
.loader.out .ld__bg{transform:translateY(-100%)}
.ld__stack{--w:min(76vw,26rem);--h:calc(var(--w) * .27);--step:calc(var(--h) * .6);position:absolute;left:50%;top:47%;width:var(--w);height:calc(var(--h) + 5 * var(--step));translate:-50% -50%}
@media (max-width:639.98px){.ld__stack{--w:min(78vw,20rem)}}
.ld__pill{position:absolute;left:0;top:calc(var(--k) * var(--step));width:100%;height:var(--h);border-radius:999px;z-index:var(--k);
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;padding:calc(var(--h) * .2) 0 0 calc(var(--w) * .16);font-size:max(11px,calc(var(--w) * .036));font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;
  background:var(--c);

.pill__in{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.75rem;border-radius:9999px;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;padding:.875rem 1.75rem;white-space:nowrap}
.pill--arrow .pill__in{padding:.375rem .375rem .375rem 1.5rem}
.pill--dark .pill__in{background:var(--btn-bg);color:var(--btn-fg)}
.pill--light .pill__in{background:var(--surface);color:var(--foreground)}
.pill--outline .pill__in{border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--foreground)}
.pill--outline:hover .pill__in{background:var(--outline-h)}
.pill__badge{width:2.25rem;height:2.25rem;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:9999px;font-size:1rem;background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.pill--dark .pill__badge{background:var(--btn-badge-bg);color:var(--btn-badge-fg)}

/* hero card */
.hcard{width:100%;max-width:24rem;border-radius:var(--radius-card-sm);background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);padding:.5rem;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(230,229,226,.7),0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.05);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  --from:translateY(16px) scale(.96);--d:400ms;--ease:var(--e-soft)}
@media (min-width:1024px){.hcard{width:19rem}}
.hcard__row{display:flex;gap:.5rem;cursor:pointer;border-radius:var(--radius-control)}
.hcard__tile{aspect-ratio:1;width:6rem;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:var(--radius-control);background:var(--ink);font-size:1.875rem;color:var(--accent-from)}
.hcard__panel{flex:1;min-width:0;border-radius:var(--radius-control);background:rgba(241,240,238,.7);padding:.75rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:.5rem}
.slot{position:relative;min-height:3.25rem}
.slide{position:absolute;inset:0;transition:transform .5s var(--e-snap),opacity .4s var(--e-snap)}
.slide__cap{font-size:.65rem;font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.45)}
.slide__ttl{max-width:8rem;margin-top:.15rem;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.35}
.hcard__ctrl{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.dots{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.25rem}
.dots i{display:block;height:.25rem;width:.375rem;border-radius:9999px;background:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.2);transition:all .3s}
.dots i.on{width:1rem;background:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.7)}
.arrows{display:flex;gap:.25rem}
.rnd{width:1.75rem;height:1.75rem;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:9999px;background:#fff;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.7);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line);font-size:.8rem;transition:color .2s}
.rnd:hover{color:var(--foreground)}
.rnd--prev svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}

/* partners */
.partners{width:100%;max-width:24rem;--from:translateY(14px);--d:550ms}
@media (min-width:1024px){.partners{width:auto;max-width:none}.partners ul{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,auto);justify-content:start;column-gap:1rem}}
.partners__lbl{margin-bottom:.75rem;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.45);text-align:left}
.partners ul{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);column-gap:1rem;row-gap:.75rem}
.partners li>span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.375rem;font-size:.75rem;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.7);opacity:.7}
.partners li svg{font-size:.875rem;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.4)}

/* status bar */
.hero__bar{position:relative;z-index:20;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:.75rem;height:var(--bar-h);border-top:1px solid rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.1);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.025em;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.72);--from:none;--d:900ms}
/* ---------- my story: a timeline you scroll through naturally; the year and title stay beside it ---------- */
.story{position:relative;z-index:1;background:#F4F1EE;border-top:1px solid rgba(26,24,24,.1);box-shadow:inset 0 1.75rem 2.25rem -1.75rem rgba(26,24,24,.14);--warm:0}
html[data-mode="dark"] .story{background:#171515;border-top-color:rgba(232,228,224,.08);box-shadow:inset 0 1.75rem 2.25rem -1.75rem rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.story::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:var(--warm);
  background:radial-gradient(60% 50% at 25% 40%,rgba(196,150,100,.12),transparent 70%),linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(170,125,80,.06))}
/* the story's backdrop, plus a soft light in the colour of the work each chapter was about (the doors'
   colours), which changes as you move from chapter to chapter.
   Light mode: soft washes of colour bleeding in from the edges, over a very fine diagonal weave — the
   middle stays clean paper so the writing is never fighting the background.
   Dark mode: the fine dots it has always had. */
.story{
  background-image:
    repeating-linear-gradient(42deg,rgba(26,24,24,.022) 0 1px,transparent 1px 12px),
    linear-gradient(176deg,#FBF9F7 0%,#F7F4F1 54%,#F3EFEB 100%);
  background-attachment:local,local}
html[data-mode="dark"] .story{
  background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(232,228,224,.055) 1px,transparent 1.4px);
  background-size:1.6rem 1.6rem;background-position:center top;background-attachment:scroll}
.story__amb{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:0;display:block;height:100svh;margin-bottom:-100svh;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;--aa:2.3;--p1:0% 14%;--p2:100% 86%}
html[data-mode="dark"] .story__amb{--aa:1.1;--p1:24% 44%;--p2:80% 74%}
/* light mode: the colour is real, but it stays out towards the edges and a soft light sits
   over the middle, so every word is read against near-white paper */
.story__amb::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(54% 66% at 50% 50%,rgba(252,250,248,.9) 0%,rgba(252,250,248,.66) 46%,transparent 80%)}
html[data-mode="dark"] .story__amb::after{display:none}
.story__amb i{position:absolute;inset:-8%;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.2s ease;
  background:radial-gradient(46% 54% at var(--p1),rgba(var(--c1),calc(.34 * var(--aa))),transparent 74%),radial-gradient(42% 48% at var(--p2),rgba(var(--c2),calc(.26 * var(--aa))),transparent 74%);
  animation:ambDrift 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate;animation-play-state:paused}
/* light mode: the colours as soft light on paper; dark mode: the doors' own deeper colours glowing in the dark */
.story__amb i:nth-child(1){--c1:226,122,58;--c2:92,132,202}     /* independent freelancer: everything, warm */
.story__amb i:nth-child(2){--c1:226,122,58;--c2:206,138,150}    /* BlockChain Engineer */
.story__amb i:nth-child(3){--c1:132,174,104;--c2:92,132,202}    /* DevOps Engineer */
.story__amb i:nth-child(4){--c1:178,106,148;--c2:226,122,58}    /* BlockChain Engineer intern */
.story__amb i:nth-child(5){--c1:226,178,70;--c2:178,142,132}    /* computer science degree */
html[data-mode="dark"] .story__amb i:nth-child(1){--c1:164,85,44;--c2:60,82,120}
html[data-mode="dark"] .story__amb i:nth-child(2){--c1:164,85,44;--c2:196,176,176}
html[data-mode="dark"] .story__amb i:nth-child(3){--c1:122,134,112;--c2:60,82,120}
html[data-mode="dark"] .story__amb i:nth-child(4){--c1:74,53,64;--c2:164,85,44}
html[data-mode="dark"] .story__amb i:nth-child(5){--c1:214,178,110;--c2:107,92,92}
.story[data-ch="0"] .story__amb i:nth-child(1),.story[data-ch="1"] .story__amb i:nth-child(2),.story[data-ch="2"] .story__amb i:nth-child(3),
.story[data-ch="3"] .story__amb i:nth-child(4),.story[data-ch="4"] .story__amb i:nth-child(5){opacity:1;animation-play-state:running}
@keyframes ambDrift{from{transform:translate3d(-2%,-1.5%,0) scale(1)}to{transform:translate3d(2.5%,2%,0) scale(1.06)}}
html.lite .story__amb i{animation:none}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.story__amb i{animation:none;transition:none}}
.story__track,.story__pin{position:relative}
.story__pin{padding:7rem 0 2.5rem}
.story__stage{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.1fr);gap:3.5rem;align-items:start;width:100%}
.story__clock{position:sticky;top:0;height:100svh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;margin-top:-7rem;padding-top:3rem}
.story__bg{position:absolute;left:-40%;right:-40%;top:0;height:100%;width:180%;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none;
  -webkit-mask:radial-gradient(closest-side,#000 55%,transparent);mask:radial-gradient(closest-side,#000 55%,transparent)}
.story__h{margin-top:.6rem;font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:700;line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.035em}
@media (min-width:1024px){.story__h{font-size:3.4rem}}
.story__yr{display:flex;margin:1.5rem 0 0 -.04em;font-size:clamp(5.5rem,11.5vw,11.5rem);font-weight:700;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.06em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--foreground)}
.dg{display:block;height:1em;overflow:hidden;padding-right:.02em}
.dg__c{display:flex;flex-direction:column;transform:translateY(calc(var(--d,0) * -1em));transition:transform .9s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.2,1)}
.dg:nth-child(2) .dg__c{transition-delay:.04s}.dg:nth-child(3) .dg__c{transition-delay:.08s}.dg:nth-child(4) .dg__c{transition-delay:.12s}
.dg__c i{display:block;height:1em;font-style:normal;text-align:center}
.story__when{margin-top:.9rem;font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#6B4F4F}
html[data-mode="dark"] .story__when{color:#D9C6C6}
.story__meter{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;margin-top:1.5rem;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--foreground);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;width:100%}
.story__of{color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.55)}
.story__rw{width:1.25rem;height:1.25rem;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.6);transform:rotate(calc(var(--p,0) * -720deg))}
.story__bar{position:relative;flex:0 1 11rem;height:2px;margin-left:.6rem;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.12);overflow:hidden}
.story__bar b{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--foreground);transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(var(--p,0))}
/* the chapters, in normal flow: the line runs beside them and the dot travels it as you scroll */
.story__line{position:relative;padding-top:24vh;padding-bottom:4vh}
.story__list{position:relative;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 0 0 2.75rem}
.story__rail{position:absolute;left:.45rem;top:var(--r0,0);height:var(--rh,0);width:2px;border-radius:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--foreground) 0%,var(--foreground) var(--dp,0%),rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.14) var(--dp,0%))}
.story__rail{background:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.14)!important}
/* the dot rides the line on the browser's own scrolling (sticky), so it never shakes; it stops at the line's ends */
/* the track reaches a dot's radius (and its halo) past each end of the line, so at the very start and end the dot sits whole on the line's tip */
.story__dtrack{position:absolute;left:calc(.45rem + 1px - 1.25rem);width:2.5rem;top:calc(var(--r0,0px) - 1rem);height:calc(var(--rh,0px) + 2rem);padding-block:.45rem;overflow:clip;pointer-events:none}
.story.at-start .story__dot::before{opacity:0}
.story__dot{position:sticky;display:block;top:calc(50svh - .55rem);margin:0 auto;width:1.1rem;height:1.1rem;border-radius:50%;z-index:2;
  background:var(--foreground);box-shadow:0 0 0 .4rem rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.08);transition:background .4s,box-shadow .4s}
/* the stretch of line already travelled, drawn as a tail above the dot */
.story__dot::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:50%;width:2px;height:300vh;margin-left:-1px;background:var(--foreground);z-index:-1}
/* the dot's track reaches a dot's width past both ends of the line, so the dot is never cut off at the start or the end */
.story__dtrack{top:calc(var(--r0,0px) - 1rem)!important;height:calc(var(--rh,0px) + 2rem)!important;padding:.45rem 0;z-index:2;overflow:visible!important}
/* the travelled stretch of line is drawn in its own track that stops exactly at the line's ends */
.story__ttrack{position:absolute;left:calc(.45rem + 1px - 1.25rem);width:2.5rem;top:var(--r0,0);height:var(--rh,0);overflow:clip;pointer-events:none;z-index:1}
.story__tail{position:sticky;display:block;top:50svh;width:2px;height:0;margin:0 auto}
.story__tail::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:2px;height:300vh;background:var(--foreground)}
.story__dot::before{display:none}
.story.is-now .story__dot{background:#7FB069;box-shadow:0 0 0 .45rem rgba(127,176,105,.18)}
.ch{position:relative;padding:3rem 0;opacity:.52;transition:opacity .45s ease}
html:not([data-mode="dark"]) .ch__b li{color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.9)}
html:not([data-mode="dark"]) .ch__org{color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.82)}
html:not([data-mode="dark"]) .ch__date{color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.78)}
html:not([data-mode="dark"]) .ch.on{opacity:1}
html:not([data-mode="dark"]) .story__when{color:#5C4242}
.ch.on{opacity:1}
.ch__date{font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.66);margin-bottom:.7rem}
.ch__t{font-size:1.9rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:.35rem}
.ch__org{font-size:1.0625rem;font-weight:500;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.7);margin-bottom:1rem}
.ch__b{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.55rem;max-width:46ch}
.ch__b li{position:relative;padding-left:1.1rem;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.55;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.78)}
.ch__b li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:.72em;width:.45rem;height:1.5px;background:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.45)}
@media (min-width:1280px){.ch__t{font-size:2.15rem}}
/* phones: title and year pin to the top, the chapters scroll under them */
@media (max-width:767.98px){
  .story__pin{padding:0 0 1.5rem}
  .story__stage{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}
  .story__clock{top:0;padding-top:calc(var(--hdr-h,4.4rem) + 1rem)!important;height:auto;margin:0 -1.25rem;padding:1.25rem 1.25rem .9rem;z-index:3;justify-content:flex-start;
    background:#F4F1EE;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(26,24,24,.1);box-shadow:0 10px 16px -12px rgba(26,24,24,.25)}
  html[data-mode="dark"] .story__clock{background:#171515;border-bottom-color:rgba(232,228,224,.08);box-shadow:0 10px 16px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
  .story__bg{display:none}
  .story__clock .eyebrow{display:none}
  .story__h{margin-top:0;font-size:1.6rem}

  .story__when{margin-top:.25rem;font-size:.6875rem}

  .ch__t{font-size:1.45rem}

}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ch{opacity:1}.dg__c{transition:none}.story__bg{display:none}}
.hero__bar .mid{display:none}

.hero__bar .scroll{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem}

/* ---------- pull cord (mode switch) ---------- */
.cord{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;width:min(100%,340px);height:520px;z-index:70;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.cord__cv{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.cord__hit{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:64px;height:64px;margin:-32px 0 0 -32px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:none;cursor:grab;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.cord__hit:active,.cord.dragging .cord__hit{cursor:grabbing}
.cord__hit:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:-10px}
.cord.dragging{cursor:grabbing}

/* ---------- section 2: the doors ---------- */
:root{
  --wall:#DAD4CF; --wall-hi:#E4DFDB; --floor:#C2AE98; --floor-2:#A8937E; --casing:#F2EFEC; --base:#EAE6E2;
  --paint:#1A1818; --lamp:rgba(255,250,242,.9); --spill:255,196,128;
  --room-in:#ffdcae; --room-mid:#c98447; --room-out:#22160d;
}
html[data-mode="dark"]{
  --wall:#1F1C1C; --wall-hi:#262222; --floor:#2B221C; --floor-2:#1A1410; --casing:#3A3434; --base:#2F2A2A;
  --paint:#E8E4E0; --lamp:rgba(232,214,210,.06);
}
.doors{position:relative;z-index:1;margin-top:-2rem;padding-top:calc(2rem + 5.25rem);overflow:hidden;
  background:
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.05) 0%,transparent 22%,transparent 78%,rgba(0,0,0,.07) 100%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,var(--wall-hi) 0%,var(--wall) 55%);
}
/* plaster texture on its own layer: it fades out while you walk through a door, so the zoom stays smooth */
.doors__tex{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:url("data:image/webp;base64,"),url("data:image/webp;base64,");background-size:auto,900px 900px;transition:opacity .25s ease}
.doors.lift .doors__tex,.doors.through .doors__tex{opacity:0}
.hero{z-index:2;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(26,24,24,.1),0 1.75rem 3rem -1.5rem rgba(26,24,24,.3)}
html[data-mode="dark"] .hero{box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(232,228,224,.08),0 1.75rem 3rem -1.25rem rgba(0,0,0,.85)}
.mbr{display:none}@media (max-width:639.98px){.mbr{display:inline}}
.doors__wall{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3.6rem}
.paint{position:relative;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;margin:0;text-align:center;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:.95;color:var(--paint);
  font-size:2.6rem;max-width:14ch;text-wrap:balance;opacity:1;padding:.08em 0 .14em;
  clip-path:inset(-20% -6% -30% -6%)}

.doors__row{--gap:1.5rem;position:relative;z-index:2;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:var(--gap);align-items:end;width:100%;transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)}
@media (min-width:1024px){.doors__row{--gap:3rem}}
/* the fifth door (Traveller) waits just past the end of the wall; the menu slides the wall along to it */
.unit.unit--secret{position:absolute;bottom:0;--slot:calc((100% - 3 * var(--gap)) / 4);width:min(17.5rem,calc((100svh - 19.5rem) / 2.25),var(--slot));
  left:calc(100% + var(--gap) + (var(--slot) - min(17.5rem,calc((100svh - 19.5rem) / 2.25),var(--slot))) / 2);visibility:hidden;opacity:0;
  transition:opacity .6s ease .2s,visibility 0s linear .8s}
.doors.reveal .doors__row{transform:translateX(calc(-1 * ((100% - 3 * var(--gap)) / 4 + var(--gap))))}
.doors.reveal .unit.unit--secret{visibility:visible;opacity:1;transition:opacity .6s ease .15s,visibility 0s}
.doors__row::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-50vw;right:-50vw;bottom:0;height:1.5rem;z-index:-1;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0,rgba(255,255,255,.55) 1px,rgba(0,0,0,.06) 2px,transparent 4px,transparent 7px,rgba(0,0,0,.05) 8px,rgba(255,255,255,.25) 9px,transparent 11px,rgba(0,0,0,.08) 100%),var(--base);
  box-shadow:0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.07),0 -.5rem .9rem -.45rem rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
html[data-mode="dark"] .doors__row::after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06) 0,rgba(255,255,255,.06) 1px,rgba(0,0,0,.3) 2px,transparent 4px,transparent 7px,rgba(0,0,0,.25) 8px,transparent 11px,rgba(0,0,0,.3) 100%),var(--base);

.doors__floor{position:relative;height:6.5rem;overflow:hidden;perspective:22rem;perspective-origin:50% 0;background:var(--floor-2)}
.doors__floor::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-60%;right:-60%;top:0;height:600%;transform-origin:50% 0;transform:rotateX(72deg);

<script>
(() => {
  const M = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const tick = () => { const d = new Date(), h = d.getHours();
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-ftime]').forEach(e => e.textContent = `${h % 12 || 12}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}${h < 12 ? 'am' : 'pm'}`);
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-fyear]').forEach(e => e.textContent = d.getFullYear()); };
  tick(); setInterval(tick, 20000);
  // size the footer name so it spans the full width with only a sliver of margin
  const fit = () => document.querySelectorAll('.sf').forEach(f => {
    const w = f.querySelector('.sf__word'); if (!w) return;
    const span = [...w.children].find(s => getComputedStyle(s).display !== 'none'); if (!span) return;
    w.style.setProperty('--wf', '100px');
    const k = (f.clientWidth * .955) / span.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    f.style.setProperty('--wf', (100 * k).toFixed(2) + 'px'); w.style.removeProperty('--wf');
  });
  fit(); addEventListener('resize', fit); document.fonts?.ready.then(fit);
  // the footer's rounded corners show whatever sits directly above it: find that section's colour and paint it behind them
  const sfw = document.querySelector('.sfw');
  const above = () => {
    if (!sfw) return;
    const solid = e => { const c = getComputedStyle(e).backgroundColor; const m = c.match(/[\d.]+/g); return m && !(m.length > 3 && +m[3] < .05) ? c : ''; };
    let col = '', e = sfw.previousElementSibling;
    while (e){ if (e.getBoundingClientRect().width >= innerWidth * .9){ const c = solid(e); if (c) col = c; } e = e.lastElementChild; }
    const bg = col || solid(document.body) || getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).backgroundColor;
    sfw.style.setProperty('--above', bg);
    // a dark section above: a hairline keeps the footer reading as its own section
    const m = (bg.match(/[\d.]+/g) || [255, 255, 255]).map(Number);
    sfw.classList.toggle('sfw--dark', (.2126 * m[0] + .7152 * m[1] + .0722 * m[2]) / 255 < .25);
  };
  above(); addEventListener('load', above); addEventListener('resize', above);
  new MutationObserver(above).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-mode'] });
  // floating back-to-top: appears after the first screen, shows scroll progress, flips colour over dark backgrounds
  const tt = document.querySelector('.totop');
  if (tt) {
    const c = tt.querySelector('.ring circle'); tt.style.setProperty('--len', (2 * Math.PI * 24).toFixed(2));
    const lum = el => { for (let e = el; e && e !== document.documentElement; e = e.parentElement) {
        const m = getComputedStyle(e).backgroundColor.match(/[\d.]+/g); if (!m) continue;
        if (m.length > 3 && +m[3] < .5) continue; return (.2126 * m[0] + .7152 * m[1] + .0722 * m[2]) / 255; }
      const m = getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor.match(/[\d.]+/g) || [255,255,255];
      return (m.length > 3 && +m[3] < .5) ? (document.documentElement.dataset.mode === 'dark' ? 0 : 1) : (.2126 * m[0] + .7152 * m[1] + .0722 * m[2]) / 255; };
    let raf = 0;
    const upd = () => { raf = 0;
      const max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight, y = scrollY;
      const bot = document.querySelector('.sf__bot');  // the footer has its own 'Back to top', so step aside once it's on screen
      tt.classList.toggle('show', y > innerHeight * .9 && !(bot && bot.getBoundingClientRect().top < innerHeight - 8));
      tt.style.setProperty('--p', max > 0 ? Math.min(1, y / max).toFixed(4) : 0);
      const r = tt.getBoundingClientRect();
      tt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      const under = document.elementFromPoint(r.left + r.width / 2, r.top + r.height / 2);
      tt.style.pointerEvents = '';
      if (under) tt.dataset.on = lum(under) < .45 ? 'dark' : 'light'; };
    const q = () => { if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(upd); };
    addEventListener('scroll', q, { passive: true }); addEventListener('resize', q);
    new MutationObserver(q).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-mode', 'class'] });
    upd();
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
// press F for full screen (again, or Esc, to leave); ignored while typing
(() => {
  const typing = e => { const t = e.target; return t && (t.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(t.tagName)); };
  const toggle = () => {
    const d = document, el = d.documentElement;
    if (d.fullscreenElement || d.webkitFullscreenElement) (d.exitFullscreen || d.webkitExitFullscreen).call(d);
    else (el.requestFullscreen || el.webkitRequestFullscreen)?.call(el)?.catch?.(() => {});
  };
  addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if ((e.key !== 'f' && e.key !== 'F') || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || typing(e)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (window.top !== window) { try { parent.postMessage({ wall: 'fullscreen' }, location.origin === 'null' ? '*' : location.origin); } catch (_) {} return; }
    toggle();
  });
  if (window.top === window) addEventListener('message', e => {
    // only one of this page's own frames can ask for full screen
    if (!e.data || e.data.wall !== 'fullscreen' || ![...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].some(f => f.contentWindow === e.source)) return;
    toggle();
  });
})();

/* ---------- adaptive grid scale-up above 1920px ---------- */
function applyAdaptiveGrid(){
  const FONT_BASE = 16, baseWidth = 1920, coef = 0.6666;
  const w = window.innerWidth;
  const widthReduction = ((baseWidth - w) / baseWidth) * 100;
  const size = FONT_BASE - (FONT_BASE * (widthReduction * coef)) / 100;
  if (size > FONT_BASE) root.style.fontSize = size + 'px';
  else root.style.removeProperty('font-size');
}
applyAdaptiveGrid(); addEventListener('resize', applyAdaptiveGrid);

/* ---------- scroll lock (Lenis attached once loaded) ---------- */
let lenis = null, scrollEnabled = true, locks = 0;
// touch state shared by the pinned sections: never snap while a finger is down or a flick is still coasting
window.__touching = false;
addEventListener('touchstart', () => { window.__touching = true; }, { passive: true, capture: true });
addEventListener('touchend', () => { window.__touching = false; }, { passive: true, capture: true });
addEventListener('touchcancel', () => { window.__touching = false; }, { passive: true, capture: true });
const COARSE = matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches;
window.__snapTo = top => { if (!COARSE && window.__lenis) window.__lenis.scrollTo(top, { duration: .6, easing: x => 1 - Math.pow(1 - x, 3) }); else scrollTo({ top, behavior: matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth' }); };
function stopScroll(){ locks++; scrollEnabled = false; lenis?.stop(); Object.assign(root.style, { position:'relative', overflow:'hidden', height:'100%' }); }

/* ---------- spring helper (mass 1, semi-implicit Euler) ---------- */
function spring({ tension, friction }, render){
  let x = 0, v = 0, target = 0, raf = 0;
  const step = () => {
    const dt = 1 / 60, a = tension * (target - x) - friction * v;
    v += a * dt; x += v * dt; render(x);
    if (Math.abs(target - x) < 0.001 && Math.abs(v) < 0.001){ x = target; v = 0; render(x); raf = 0; return; }
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };
  render(0);
  return { set(t){ target = t; if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step); } };
}
// declarative hovers: data-h="s 1 1.04|y 0 -2|o .8 1"  data-hs="tension friction"  data-ht="closest trigger"
function bindHovers(scope = document){
  scope.querySelectorAll('[data-h]').forEach(el => {
    if (el._h) return; el._h = 1;
    const props = el.dataset.h.split('|').map(p => { const [k, a, b] = p.trim().split(/\s+/); return { k, a:+a, b:+b }; });
    const [tension, friction] = (el.dataset.hs || '320 18').split(/\s+/).map(Number);
    const trig = el.dataset.ht ? el.closest(el.dataset.ht) || el : el;
    const render = p => {
      const v = { s:1, x:0, y:0, r:0 };
      let o = null;
      props.forEach(({ k, a, b }) => { const val = a + (b - a) * p; if (k === 'o') o = val; else v[k] = val; });
      el.style.transform = `translate(${v.x}px,${v.y}px) rotate(${v.r}deg) scale(${v.s})`;
      if (o !== null) el.style.opacity = o;
    };
    const s = spring({ tension, friction }, render);
    if (!canHover) return;
    trig.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => s.set(1));
    trig.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => s.set(0));
    trig.addEventListener('focusin', () => s.set(1));
    trig.addEventListener('focusout', () => s.set(0));
  });
}

/* ---------- overlays ---------- */
const FOCUSABLE = 'a[href],button:not([disabled]),input:not([disabled]),select:not([disabled]),textarea:not([disabled]),[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
function openLayer(el, onKey){
  el.hidden = false; stopScroll();
  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => el.classList.add('open')));
  el._key = e => {
    if (e.key === 'Escape'){ onKey(); return; }
    // keep Tab inside the open layer: without this the keyboard walks onto the page behind it
    if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
    const f = [...el.querySelectorAll(FOCUSABLE)].filter(n => n.offsetWidth || n.offsetHeight || n.getClientRects().length);
    if (!f.length) return;
    const first = f[0], last = f[f.length - 1];
    if (!el.contains(document.activeElement)){ e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); return; }
    if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first){ e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
    else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last){ e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
  };
  addEventListener('keydown', el._key);
}
function closeLayer(el, after){
  if (el.hidden) return;
  el.classList.remove('open'); el.classList.add('closing');
  removeEventListener('keydown', el._key);
  setTimeout(() => { el.hidden = true; el.classList.remove('closing'); startScroll(); after?.(); }, 460);
}
// nav menu
const NAV = [['Home','home'],['Web Developer',0],['AI Enginner',1],['DevOps Engineer',2],['BlockChain Engineer',3],['My story','about'],['Contact',null]];
const navm = $('#navm');
$('#navList').innerHTML = NAV.map(([l, id], i) =>

// request modal
const CONTACT_EMAIL = ['Bornebytethakor218', 'gmail.com'].join('@');   // where project requests go (assembled here so address-harvesting bots don't find it in the page)
document.querySelectorAll('[data-mail]').forEach(a => { a.href = 'mailto:' + CONTACT_EMAIL; a.textContent = CONTACT_EMAIL; });

// the form sends for real only on the live website (Netlify receives it); anywhere else it opens an email

/* ---------- Flip calendar: skills on an endless desk-calendar flip ---------- */
(function flipCalendar(){
  const SKILLS = ['Web Developer', 'AI Engineer', 'DevOps Engineer', 'BlockChain Engineer', 'Traveller'];
  const HOLD = 1700, FLIP = 1250;
  const cal = $('#cal'); if (!cal) return;
  const body = $('.cal__body', cal), leaf = $('.cal__leaf', cal);
  const under = $('[data-under]', cal), face = $('.cal__face', cal);
  const measure = $('.cal__measure', cal), rings = $('.cal__rings', cal);
  const n = SKILLS.length;
  let i = 0, timer = 0, flipping = false, started = false;

  const paint = (page, k) => {
    $('.cal__word', page).textContent = SKILLS[k];
    $('.cal__no', page).textContent = `${String(k + 1).padStart(2, '0')} / ${String(n).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };
  paint(face, 0); paint(under, 1);

  // size the page to the longest skill, shrink the whole calendar if the column is too narrow
  function fit(){
    cal.style.fontSize = '';
    const fs = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(cal).fontSize);
    let max = 0;
    for (const w of SKILLS){ measure.textContent = w; max = Math.max(max, measure.getBoundingClientRect().width); }
    const wEm = max / fs + 0.8 + 0.06;               // word + side padding
    body.style.setProperty('--cal-w', wEm.toFixed(3) + 'em');
    cal.style.setProperty('--cal-w', wEm.toFixed(3) + 'em');
    const avail = cal.closest('.h1').getBoundingClientRect().width - fs * 0.25;
    const need = wEm * fs;
    if (need > avail) cal.style.fontSize = (fs * avail / need).toFixed(2) + 'px';
    // spiral rings + punched holes, spaced roughly every 0.62em
    const count = Math.max(5, Math.round((wEm - 0.64) / 0.7) + 1);
    rings.innerHTML = '<i></i>'.repeat(count);
    cal.querySelectorAll('.cal__holes').forEach(h => h.innerHTML = '<i></i>'.repeat(count));
  }
  fit();
  document.fonts?.ready.then(fit);
  addEventListener('resize', () => { clearTimeout(fit._t); fit._t = setTimeout(fit, 120); });

  function flip(){
    if (document.hidden){ timer = setTimeout(flip, 600); return; }
    flipping = true;
    const next = (i + 1) % n;
    if (reduced){
      i = next; paint(face, i); paint(under, (i + 1) % n);
      flipping = false; timer = setTimeout(flip, HOLD + 700); return;
    }
    const timing = { duration: FLIP, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.5,.05,.2,1)', fill: 'forwards' };
    face.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 1, offset: .285 }, { opacity: 0, offset: .295 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: FLIP, easing: 'linear', fill: 'forwards' });
    // once the page is over the top it slips away behind the calendar instead of hanging over the text
    // the back of the page catches the light as it comes over the top, then falls into shadow as it drops behind the stack
    $('.cal__rear', leaf).animate([{ filter: 'brightness(1)' }, { filter: 'brightness(1.02)', offset: .29 }, { filter: 'brightness(.96)', offset: .45 }, { filter: 'brightness(.9)' }], { duration: FLIP, easing: 'linear', fill: 'forwards' });
    const a = leaf.animate([
      { transform: 'translateZ(.004em) rotateX(0deg)' },
      { transform: 'translateZ(.004em) rotateX(352deg)' }
    ], timing);
    $('.cal__shade', face).animate([{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: .45, offset: .2 }, { opacity: 0, offset: .275 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: FLIP, easing: 'linear', fill: 'forwards' });
    $('.cal__shade', under).animate([{ opacity: .7 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: FLIP * .9, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.3,.6,.4,1)', fill: 'forwards' });
    a.onfinish = () => {
      i = next;
      paint(face, i);                       // the leaf now shows what was underneath…
      leaf.getAnimations({ subtree: true }).forEach(x => x.cancel());
      cal.querySelectorAll('.cal__shade').forEach(sh => sh.getAnimations().forEach(x => x.cancel()));
      paint(under, (i + 1) % n);            // …and the next skill waits below
      flipping = false;
      timer = setTimeout(flip, HOLD);
    };
  }
  const start = () => { if (started) return; started = true; timer = setTimeout(flip, 1300); };
  if (document.body.classList.contains('ready')) start(); else addEventListener('intro:ready', start, { once: true });
})();


/* ---------- LiquidReveal: paint the colour cut-out along the cursor trail ----------
   The trail is kept as a soft mask; each frame the canvas shows  bw·(1−mask) + colour·mask
   (added with 'lighter'), so semi-transparent hair edges keep exactly the same opacity
   instead of doubling up where the colour layer sits on the B&W one. */
function liquidReveal(stage, canvas, afterSrc, { brushRadius = 143, decay = 0.016 } = {}){
  if (reduced) { canvas.remove(); return; }
  const base = stage.querySelector('img');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
  const mk = () => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); return [c, c.getContext('2d')]; };
  const [bwC, bwX] = mk(), [colC, colX] = mk(), [mask, mX] = mk(), [tmp, tX] = mk();
  const bwImg = new Image(), colImg = new Image();
  bwImg.src = base.currentSrc || base.src; colImg.src = afterSrc;
  let W = 1, H = 1, radius = brushRadius * dpr;
  const points = []; let last = null, idle = 999, running = false, showing = false;

  function fitDraw(x, img){
    x.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    if (!img.naturalWidth) return;
    // object-fit: contain + object-position: 50% 100%  (matches the base <img>)

<script>
// my story: you scroll the chapters naturally. The dot travels the line in step with the page, the year rolls back as each
// chapter reaches the middle of the screen, and (on larger screens) the clock tunnel behind the year turns with your scroll.
(() => {
  const sec = document.querySelector('.story'); if (!sec) return;
  const line = sec.querySelector('.story__line'), list = sec.querySelector('.story__list');
  const chs = [...list.querySelectorAll('.ch')], N = chs.length;
  const cols = [...sec.querySelectorAll('.dg__c')], when = sec.querySelector('.story__when'), count = sec.querySelector('.story__count');
  const dot = sec.querySelector('.story__dot'), rail = sec.querySelector('.story__rail'), cv = sec.querySelector('.story__bg'), ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  const root = document.documentElement;
  let shownYear = '', shown = -1;
  const setYear = y => { if (y === shownYear) return; shownYear = y; String(y).split('').forEach((d, k) => cols[k] && cols[k].style.setProperty('--d', d)); };
  const show = i => {
    if (i === shown) return; shown = i;
    chs.forEach((c, k) => c.classList.toggle('on', k === i));
    setYear(chs[i].dataset.y); when.textContent = chs[i].dataset.when; count.textContent = String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    sec.classList.toggle('is-now', i === 0);
    sec.dataset.ch = i;                                     // the backdrop light takes this chapter's colour
  };
  // ---- the tunnel ----
  let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1, rgb = '26,24,24';
  const size = () => { dpr = Math.min(2, devicePixelRatio || 1); W = cv.clientWidth; H = cv.clientHeight; cv.width = W * dpr; cv.height = H * dpr; };
  const readRgb = () => { rgb = (getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--fg-rgb') || '26,24,24').trim(); };
  new MutationObserver(readRgb).observe(root, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-mode'] });
  const RINGS = 16, GAP = 340, FOCAL = 520, R = 620, TICKS = 60;
  const dust = Array.from({ length: 70 }, () => ({ a: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2, r: 120 + Math.random() * 760, z: Math.random() * RINGS * GAP, s: .6 + Math.random() * 1.4 }));
  function tunnel(p, t){
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0); ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

      }

  readRgb(); measure(); show(0); update();
  document.fonts?.ready.then(() => { measure(); q(); });

})();
</script>

<meta name="description" content="Freelance developer and designer building websites, iOS apps and brand design for clients in the US, UK and worldwide. Working remotely, replies within 5 hours." />
<meta name="theme-color" content="#1A1818" />
<style>
/* Layout: full-bleed hero (light + charcoal dark mode) — greeting + flip-calendar skills top-left, card bottom-left, cut-out portrait anchored right on the status hairline. */
:root{
  --background:#E8E4E0; --foreground:#1A1818; --ink:#1A1818;
  --muted:#857878; --subtle:#B5A8A8; --line:#D5CDCA;
  --surface:#DED8D4; --surface-2:#D3CBC8;
  --accent:#6B5C5C; --accent-from:#C4B0B0; --accent-to:#6B5C5C;
  --hero-from:#EEEAE6; --hero-mid:#E8E4E0; --hero-to:#D8CDCA;
  --radius-pill:9999px; --radius-card:2rem; --radius-card-sm:1.25rem; --radius-control:.875rem;
  --text-watermark:13rem; --container-shell:88rem;
  --font:'Onest',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --e-line:cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1);
  --e-spring:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
  --e-soft:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
  --e-snap:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  --bar-h:3.5rem;
  --gut-lg:5.5rem;   /* one side margin for nav, headline, chips and portrait */
  /* mode-dependent tokens (light) */
  --fg-rgb:26,24,24;
  --chip-bg:rgba(242,238,235,.5); --chip-bg-h:rgba(242,238,235,.85); --chip-line:rgba(196,176,176,.45);
  --btn-bg:#1A1818; --btn-fg:#E8E4E0; --btn-badge-bg:#E8E4E0; --btn-badge-fg:#1A1818;
  --outline-h:rgba(196,176,176,.18);
  --vig:rgba(240,236,232,.35);
  --panel:#F0ECE9; --field:rgba(196,176,176,.12); --scrim:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.3);
  --cord-shadow:.2;
  color-scheme:light;
}
/* dark mode: charcoal, a step above pure black */
html[data-mode="dark"]{
  --background:#1A1818; --foreground:#E8E4E0; --fg-rgb:232,228,224;
  --line:rgba(196,176,176,.16); --surface:#252121; --surface-2:#302A2A;
  --chip-bg:rgba(196,176,176,.06); --chip-bg-h:rgba(196,176,176,.12); --chip-line:rgba(196,176,176,.16);
  --btn-bg:#E8E4E0; --btn-fg:#1A1818; --btn-badge-bg:#1A1818; --btn-badge-fg:#E8E4E0;
  --outline-h:rgba(196,176,176,.08);
  --vig:rgba(0,0,0,.22);
  --panel:#221F1F; --field:rgba(196,176,176,.06); --scrim:rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  --cord-shadow:.55;
  color-scheme:dark;
}
/* mode switch: one GPU crossfade of the whole page (View Transitions) instead of
   hundreds of per-element colour transitions running out of step */
::view-transition-old(root),::view-transition-new(root){animation-duration:.5s;animation-timing-function:cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}
.cord{view-transition-name:cord}
#cal{view-transition-name:cal}
::view-transition-old(cal){display:none}
::view-transition-new(cal){animation:none}
::view-transition-old(cord){display:none}
::view-transition-new(cord){animation:none}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{overscroll-behavior-y:none;scrollbar-width:none;font-size:16px;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;background:#1A1818;overflow-x:clip}
html[data-mode="dark"]{background:#0F0E0E}
html::-webkit-scrollbar,body::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;width:0;height:0}
body{background:var(--background);color:var(--foreground);font-family:var(--font);overflow-x:clip}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer}
ul{list-style:none}
img{display:block;max-width:none}
svg{display:block;width:1em;height:1em;flex:none}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.tnum{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

/* ---------- adaptive rem grid ---------- */
@media (max-width:1920px){html{font-size:.833333vw}}
@media (max-width:1440px){html{font-size:1.111111vw}}
@media (max-width:1024px){html{font-size:1.5625vw}}
@media (max-width:640px){html{font-size:4.444444vw}}

.shell{max-width:var(--container-shell);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:1.25rem;width:100%}
@media (min-width:640px){.shell{padding-inline:2rem}}
@media (min-width:1024px){.shell{padding-inline:var(--gut-lg)}}

/* ---------- skip link ---------- */
.skip{position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:auto}
.skip:focus{position:fixed;left:1rem;top:1rem;z-index:60;min-height:44px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:var(--radius-control);background:var(--ink);padding:.5rem 1rem;font-size:.875rem;color:#fff}

/* ---------- reveal system (plays once body.ready is set) ---------- */
.rv{opacity:0;transform:var(--from,translateY(10px));transition:opacity .8s var(--ease,var(--e-soft)) var(--d,0ms),transform .8s var(--ease,var(--e-soft)) var(--d,0ms)}
body.ready .rv{opacity:var(--to-o,1);transform:none}
.line{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:.06em;margin-bottom:-.06em}
.line>span{display:block;transform:translateY(100%);opacity:0;transition:transform .9s var(--e-line) var(--d,0ms),opacity .9s var(--e-line) var(--d,0ms)}
body.ready .line>span{transform:none;opacity:1}

/* ---------- loader: the doors' colours stack up, one per discipline, then slides away to open the page ---------- */
.loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:120;overflow:hidden;color:#E8E4E0;--p:0;font-family:'Onest',ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif}
.ld__bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(38% 55% at 0% 72%,rgba(164,85,44,.26),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(40% 58% at 100% 70%,rgba(196,176,176,.16),transparent 72%),
  radial-gradient(70% 60% at 50% 0%,rgba(107,92,92,.3),transparent 70%),#0D0C0C;transition:transform .85s cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1)}
.loader.out .ld__bg{transform:translateY(-100%)}
.ld__stack{--w:min(76vw,26rem);--h:calc(var(--w) * .27);--step:calc(var(--h) * .6);position:absolute;left:50%;top:47%;width:var(--w);height:calc(var(--h) + 5 * var(--step));translate:-50% -50%}
@media (max-width:639.98px){.ld__stack{--w:min(78vw,20rem)}}
.ld__pill{position:absolute;left:0;top:calc(var(--k) * var(--step));width:100%;height:var(--h);border-radius:999px;z-index:var(--k);
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;padding:calc(var(--h) * .2) 0 0 calc(var(--w) * .16);font-size:max(11px,calc(var(--w) * .036));font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;
  background:var(--c);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 88%,#fff) 0%,var(--c) 22%,var(--c) 70%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 82%,#000) 100%);color:var(--t);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14),0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 calc(var(--h) * -.18) calc(var(--h) * .35) calc(var(--h) * -.12) rgba(0,0,0,.55);
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(-1.6rem) scale(.96);transition:opacity .45s ease,transform .75s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.ld__pill.on{opacity:1;transform:none}
.ld__pill span{opacity:.82}
.loader.out .ld__pill{transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.25,1) calc(var(--k) * 45ms),opacity .5s ease calc(.25s + var(--k) * 45ms);opacity:0;
  transform:translateX(calc(var(--dir) * 115vw)) rotate(calc(var(--dir) * 4deg))}
.ld__hud{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding:clamp(1.25rem,4vw,3rem);transition:opacity .35s ease}
.loader.out .ld__hud{opacity:0}
.ld__top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:500;color:rgba(232,228,224,.7)}
.ld__top b{font-weight:600;color:#E8E4E0}
.ld__bot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:1.5rem}
.ld__num{font-size:clamp(3.5rem,9vw,7.5rem);font-weight:700;line-height:.85;letter-spacing:-.05em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#E8E4E0}
.ld__num small{display:block;margin-bottom:.9rem;font-family:ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;font-size:.6875rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(232,228,224,.62)}
.ld__bar{width:min(30vw,14rem);height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(232,228,224,.14);overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.ld__bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6B5C5C,#C4B0B0,#D6B26E);transform-origin:0 50%;transform:scaleX(var(--p))}
@media (max-width:639.98px){.ld__top span:last-child{display:none}.ld__bar{width:34vw}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ld__pill{transform:none;transition:opacity .3s ease}.loader.out .ld__pill{transform:none}.ld__bg{transition:opacity .4s ease}.loader.out .ld__bg{transform:none;opacity:0}}

/* ---------- header ---------- */
.hdr{position:fixed;inset-inline:0;top:0;z-index:50;transition:background .35s ease,box-shadow .35s ease,opacity .35s ease,translate .45s var(--e-soft);--from:translateY(-14px);--d:150ms;--ease:var(--e-spring)}
.hdr.stuck{background:var(--background);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.08)}
.hdr.stuck .hdr__in{padding-block:.85rem}
.hdr.away{opacity:0;translate:0 -100%;pointer-events:none}
.hdr__in{transition:padding .35s ease;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1.5rem;padding-block:1.25rem}
@media (min-width:640px){.hdr__in{padding-block:1.5rem}}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-size:1.375rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em}

/* one door with its casing */
.unit{position:relative;container-type:inline-size;width:100%;max-width:min(17.5rem,calc((100svh - 19.5rem) / 2.25));justify-self:center;
  transition:opacity .9s var(--e-soft),transform 1.1s var(--e-soft);transition-delay:calc(var(--i) * 110ms + .35s)}
.doors.pre .unit{opacity:0;transform:translateY(1.5rem)}
.unit::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-35%;right:-35%;top:-18%;height:62%;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1;
  background:radial-gradient(50% 50% at 50% 30%,var(--lamp),transparent 100%)}
.doorway{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/2.25;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;border-radius:50cqi 50cqi 0 0}
.doorway:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:6px}
.casing{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50cqi 50cqi 0 0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.07),rgba(255,255,255,.18) 3cqi,transparent 6cqi,transparent calc(100% - 6cqi),rgba(0,0,0,.05) calc(100% - 3cqi),rgba(0,0,0,.12)),
    linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.35),transparent 30%),var(--casing);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.1cqi rgba(255,255,255,.28),inset 0 0 0 1.5cqi rgba(0,0,0,.07),inset 0 0 0 3.6cqi rgba(255,255,255,.12),inset 0 0 0 4.1cqi rgba(0,0,0,.08),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06),1.5cqi 2.5cqi 4.5cqi rgba(26,24,24,.2),-.5cqi 1cqi 3cqi rgba(26,24,24,.08)}
html[data-mode="dark"] .casing{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.25),rgba(255,255,255,.04) 3cqi,transparent 6cqi,transparent calc(100% - 6cqi),rgba(0,0,0,.3)),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05),transparent 30%),var(--casing);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.1cqi rgba(255,255,255,.05),inset 0 0 0 1.5cqi rgba(0,0,0,.25),inset 0 0 0 3.6cqi rgba(255,255,255,.03),inset 0 0 0 4.1cqi rgba(0,0,0,.22),
    0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.4),1.5cqi 2.5cqi 5cqi rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
/* plinth blocks at the foot of each leg */
.casing::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-1cqi;right:-1cqi;bottom:0;height:11cqi;z-index:1;background:var(--casing);
  -webkit-mask:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 0 8.5cqi,transparent 8.5cqi calc(100% - 8.5cqi),#000 calc(100% - 8.5cqi));mask:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 0 8.5cqi,transparent 8.5cqi calc(100% - 8.5cqi),#000 calc(100% - 8.5cqi));
  box-shadow:inset 0 .5cqi 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4),inset 0 1cqi 0 rgba(0,0,0,.08),inset 0 -.6cqi 1cqi rgba(0,0,0,.1)}
html[data-mode="dark"] .casing::before{box-shadow:inset 0 .5cqi 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05),inset 0 1cqi 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
/* a fine bead runs round the arch, inside the frame */
.casing::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:4.6cqi;right:4.6cqi;top:4.6cqi;bottom:0;border-radius:45.4cqi 45.4cqi 0 0;border:.45cqi solid rgba(0,0,0,.07);border-bottom:0}
html[data-mode="dark"] .casing::after{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.opening{position:absolute;left:7.5cqi;right:7.5cqi;top:7.5cqi;bottom:0;perspective:160cqi;perspective-origin:50% 42%}
.room{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;border-radius:42.5cqi 42.5cqi 0 0;
  background:var(--room);
  box-shadow:inset 2cqi 0 4cqi var(--room-sh),inset 0 2cqi 4cqi var(--room-sh)}
/* the space behind the doors: white in light mode, black in dark mode */
:root{--room:#FBFAF8;--room-sh:rgba(26,24,24,.1)}
html[data-mode="dark"]{--room:#050505;--room-sh:rgba(0,0,0,.85)}
/* a dark room: only the faintest edge where the frame catches the room light */
.room::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035),transparent 12%);pointer-events:none}
/* walking through a door */
.doors.lift{will-change:transform}
/* while walking in, the wall and floor carry on past the section's edges, so nothing else shows */
.doors.through{overflow:visible;z-index:6}
.doors.through::before,.doors.through::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:55vw;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--wall-hi) 0%,var(--wall) 55%)}
.doors.through::before{right:100%}.doors.through::after{left:100%}
.doors.through .doors__floor{box-shadow:-55vw 0 0 0 var(--floor),55vw 0 0 0 var(--floor)}
.passage{position:fixed;z-index:99;background:var(--room);pointer-events:none;will-change:transform}
.shade{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:98;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;will-change:opacity;background:var(--room)}
.veil{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;pointer-events:none;clip-path:inset(50%);transition:clip-path .95s cubic-bezier(.6,0,.35,1)}
.veil.on{opacity:1}
.veil--photo{background:#030303}
.wallv{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .25s ease,visibility 0s linear .25s;background:var(--room)}
.wallv.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .25s ease,visibility 0s}
.wallv.live{pointer-events:auto}
.wallv iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;display:block;visibility:hidden}
.wallv iframe{opacity:0;transition:opacity .7s ease}
.wallv.on iframe.cur{visibility:visible;opacity:1}
.veil--wall{background:#E8E4E0;width:100vw}
html[data-mode="dark"] .veil--wall{background:#1A1818}
.vcell{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:center/cover no-repeat}
.vcell img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
/* page-to-page hand-off without a blank frame (supporting browsers) */
@view-transition{navigation:auto}
::view-transition-old(root),::view-transition-new(root){animation-duration:.25s}
.veil--glow{background:var(--room)}
.cord{transition:opacity .4s ease}
.cord.away{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.door{--dc:var(--door);position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:rotateY(0deg);will-change:transform;border-radius:42.5cqi 42.5cqi 0 0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(255,255,255,.1) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 30%,rgba(0,0,0,.18) 100%),
    var(--dc);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .3cqi rgba(0,0,0,.28),inset .6cqi 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
html[data-mode="dark"] .door{--dc:var(--door-dk,var(--door))}
/* a reeded panel, recessed into the leaf and following the arch */
.door__flute{position:absolute;left:8cqi;right:8cqi;top:8cqi;bottom:9cqi;border-radius:34.5cqi 34.5cqi 1.2cqi 1.2cqi;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.075) 0,rgba(255,255,255,.02) 1cqi,rgba(0,0,0,.13) 2.1cqi,rgba(255,255,255,.075) 2.8cqi);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .3cqi rgba(0,0,0,.16),inset 1cqi 1.2cqi 2cqi rgba(0,0,0,.28),inset -.6cqi -.6cqi 1cqi rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
/* hovering a door: it gains real depth. The slab shows its thickness as it swings, casts a shadow into the gap,
   the frame lifts off the wall and light from the room rims the opening */
.door__shade{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;background:#000;opacity:calc(var(--o,0) * .5);pointer-events:none}
.door{transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:box-shadow .5s var(--e-soft)}
.door::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:40cqi;bottom:0;right:0;width:3.4cqi;transform-origin:100% 50%;transform:rotateY(-90deg);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08),rgba(0,0,0,.25)),var(--dc);filter:brightness(.62);pointer-events:none}
.casing{transition:box-shadow .5s var(--e-soft)}
.room::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s var(--e-soft);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 5cqi var(--rim),inset 0 0 1.2cqi var(--rim)}
:root{--rim:rgba(255,255,255,.95);--lift:rgba(26,24,24,.3)}
html[data-mode="dark"]{--rim:rgba(214,196,196,.22);--lift:rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.unit.on .casing{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06),2cqi 5cqi 9cqi var(--lift),-1cqi 2cqi 5cqi rgba(0,0,0,.08),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.55)}
.unit.on .door{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 .35cqi rgba(0,0,0,.2),inset -2.5cqi 0 3cqi rgba(0,0,0,.18),4cqi 0 7cqi rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.unit.on .room::after{opacity:1}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.door,.casing,.room::after{transition:none}}
/* brass name plate */
.plate{position:absolute;left:50%;top:31%;translate:-50% -50%;width:58cqi;padding:2.6cqi 4cqi;border-radius:.9cqi;z-index:1;
  text-align:center;font-size:5.4cqi;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;text-wrap:balance;
  color:#2b2112;text-shadow:0 .28cqi 0 rgba(255,238,196,.55),0 -.15cqi 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25);
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#efdfb2 0%,#c9a866 28%,#e3cc92 48%,#a98747 72%,#d2b67a 100%);
  box-shadow:0 .5cqi 1cqi rgba(0,0,0,.4),inset 0 .3cqi 0 rgba(255,250,228,.7),inset 0 -.3cqi 0 rgba(88,62,22,.45)}
.plate::before,.plate::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:50%;width:1.6cqi;height:1.6cqi;margin-top:-.8cqi;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%,#fff3cf,#8f6f33 70%);box-shadow:0 .15cqi .2cqi rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.plate::before{left:1.8cqi}.plate::after{right:1.8cqi}
/* lever handle: a bevelled brass rose screwed to the door, a tapered lever standing off it, and a keyhole escutcheon */
.handle{position:absolute;right:7cqi;top:59%;width:9.4cqi;height:9.4cqi;border-radius:50%;z-index:1;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 36% 30%,#fff6dc 0,#e6cb8a 14%,#b8934c 40%,#80602a 70%,#4d3816 100%);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 .35cqi rgba(0,0,0,.22),.9cqi 1.5cqi 2cqi rgba(0,0,0,.45),inset -.7cqi -.9cqi 1.1cqi rgba(40,26,6,.55),inset .5cqi .6cqi .8cqi rgba(255,248,222,.5)}
/* the boss the lever turns on */
.handle::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:2.3cqi;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 38% 32%,#fff3d0,#c9a45c 45%,#6f5122 100%);box-shadow:.4cqi .7cqi .9cqi rgba(0,0,0,.45),inset 0 0 0 .2cqi rgba(255,240,200,.35)}
.handle__lever{position:absolute;right:3.6cqi;top:2.75cqi;width:23cqi;height:3.9cqi;border-radius:2.4cqi 1.6cqi 1.6cqi 2.4cqi;transform-origin:calc(100% - 1.9cqi) 50%;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff5d6 0%,#ecd395 16%,#c39d55 42%,#8e6a2d 72%,#5c4119 100%);
  box-shadow:.3cqi 2.4cqi 2.2cqi rgba(0,0,0,.38),0 .4cqi .4cqi rgba(0,0,0,.25),inset 0 -.3cqi .4cqi rgba(50,32,8,.45);
  transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.3,.7,.4,1)}
/* a slightly thicker grip at the free end, and a polished highlight running along the top */
.handle__lever::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-.4cqi;top:-.45cqi;width:7cqi;height:4.8cqi;border-radius:2.4cqi;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff5d6 0%,#e8cd8c 18%,#bf9850 45%,#86632a 75%,#5c4119 100%);box-shadow:0 .5cqi .6cqi rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.handle__lever::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:1.4cqi;right:2.6cqi;top:.55cqi;height:.55cqi;border-radius:1cqi;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,240,.95),rgba(255,250,225,.35));filter:blur(.1cqi)}
.unit.press .handle__lever{transform:rotate(-32deg)}
.handle__lock{position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(100% + 6.5cqi);width:5.4cqi;height:10.5cqi;margin-left:-2.7cqi;border-radius:2.7cqi;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 38% 28%,#fff3d0 0,#d9b86f 22%,#a07b37 55%,#5e4419 100%);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 .3cqi rgba(0,0,0,.2),.6cqi 1cqi 1.4cqi rgba(0,0,0,.42),inset -.4cqi -.6cqi .8cqi rgba(40,26,6,.5),inset .3cqi .4cqi .5cqi rgba(255,248,222,.45)}
/* the keyhole: a round top over a narrow slot */
.handle__lock::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:30%;width:2cqi;height:2cqi;margin-left:-1cqi;border-radius:50%;background:#140d04;box-shadow:inset .2cqi .3cqi .3cqi rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
.handle__lock::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:calc(30% + 1.3cqi);width:1cqi;height:3cqi;margin-left:-.5cqi;border-radius:0 0 .3cqi .3cqi;background:#140d04}
/* light from the room behind, leaking under the door */
.sill{position:absolute;left:3cqi;right:3cqi;bottom:0;height:1cqi;z-index:2;pointer-events:none;border-radius:1cqi;
  background:rgba(var(--glow),.95);filter:blur(.7cqi);opacity:.4;transition:opacity .6s var(--e-soft)}
html[data-mode="dark"] .sill{opacity:.75}
/* the polished floor picks up each door's colour and the light under it */
.pool{position:absolute;left:-10cqi;right:-10cqi;top:100%;height:40cqi;pointer-events:none;z-index:3;opacity:.55;transition:opacity .6s var(--e-soft);
  background:radial-gradient(42% 60% at 50% 0%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--door) 55%,transparent),transparent 100%),
             radial-gradient(40% 22% at 50% 0%,rgba(var(--glow),.55),transparent 100%);filter:blur(1.2cqi)}
.unit.on .sill{opacity:1}.unit.on .pool{opacity:.9}
/* no floor: the doors stand straight on the next section */
.doors__floor,.pool{display:none!important}
/* light spilling onto the floor in front of an open door */
.spill{display:none;position:absolute;left:-8cqi;right:-8cqi;top:100%;height:60cqi;pointer-events:none;z-index:3;opacity:var(--o,0);
  clip-path:polygon(12% 0,88% 0,100% 100%,0 100%);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(var(--spill),.55) 0%,rgba(var(--spill),.18) 55%,rgba(var(--spill),0) 100%);filter:blur(1.2cqi);mix-blend-mode:screen}
html:not([data-mode="dark"]) .spill{mix-blend-mode:normal;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(var(--spill),.4) 0%,rgba(var(--spill),.12) 55%,rgba(var(--spill),0) 100%)}
.leak{display:none;position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;right:0;width:3cqi;pointer-events:none;opacity:calc(var(--o,0) * 9);
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(var(--spill),.85));filter:blur(.8cqi);mix-blend-mode:screen}

/* phones: the wall pins in place and scrolling walks you along it, one door at a time */
@media (max-width:639.98px){
  .doors{padding-top:0;overflow:clip;height:calc(100svh + 3 * 55svh)}
  .doors__pin{--uw:min(56vw,calc((100svh - 31rem) / 2.25));--ug:calc(50vw - var(--uw) / 2 + .75rem);position:sticky;top:0;height:100svh;padding-top:4.75rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;background:inherit;overflow:clip}
  .doors__floor{height:3.25rem}
  .doors__wall{gap:1rem;align-items:stretch}
  .doors__row{display:flex;gap:var(--ug);overflow:visible;padding-inline:calc(50% - var(--uw) / 2);margin-inline:-1.25rem;width:calc(100% + 2.5rem);
    padding-top:2rem;margin-top:-1rem;transition:none;will-change:transform}
  .doors__row::after{left:0;right:auto;width:700vw}
  .unit{flex:0 0 var(--uw);max-width:none}
  .unit.unit--secret{position:relative;left:auto;bottom:auto;width:auto;display:none;visibility:visible;opacity:1}
  .doors.reveal .unit.unit--secret{display:block}
  .unit::before{display:none}
  .dinfo{position:relative;left:auto!important;top:auto!important;width:auto!important;max-width:100%;margin:.9rem 0 0;padding-top:1rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.1);
    text-align:left;min-height:10.5rem;opacity:1;transform:none}
  .dinfo .dinfo__h{font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:.35rem}
  .dinfo .dinfo__t{margin-bottom:.85rem;font-size:.625rem;letter-spacing:.08em;line-height:1.4}
  .dinfo .dinfo__p{font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.35;gap:.45rem}
  .dinfo .dinfo__p li{gap:.6rem}
  .dinfo .dinfo__p li::before{width:.95rem;height:.95rem;background-size:.55rem}
  .doors__dots{display:flex;gap:.4rem;margin:.25rem 0 0}
  .doors.compact .dinfo__p{display:none}
  .doors.compact .dinfo{min-height:0}
  .doors__dots i{width:.4rem;height:.4rem;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.2);transition:width .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background .35s}
  .doors__dots i.on{width:1.3rem;background:var(--foreground)}
  .doors__hint{display:none}
  .paint{font-size:2.15rem;max-width:none;white-space:nowrap;align-self:flex-start;text-align:left;margin:.25rem 0 .5rem}
}

/* "Click to enter" badge that replaces the cursor over a door */
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){ .doorway{cursor:none} }
.door-cursor{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;z-index:90;pointer-events:none;padding:.6rem 1rem;border-radius:9999px;
  background:var(--btn-bg);color:var(--btn-fg);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.01em;white-space:nowrap;
  box-shadow:0 .5rem 1.5rem -.5rem rgba(0,0,0,.45);opacity:0;transition:opacity .18s ease}
.door-cursor.on{opacity:1;scale:1}

/* ---------- skill work page (opens through a door) ---------- */
.roomv{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:105;overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;background:var(--background);color:var(--foreground);
  clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0);will-change:clip-path}
.roomv.anim{transition:clip-path .8s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)}
.roomv__glow{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;opacity:1;transition:opacity .7s ease .15s;
  background:radial-gradient(70% 45% at 55% 22%,var(--room-in) 0%,var(--room-mid) 38%,var(--room-out) 100%)}
.roomv.lit .roomv__glow{opacity:0}
.roomv__in{position:relative;z-index:1;padding-block:1.5rem 5rem;opacity:0;transform:translateY(1.25rem);transition:opacity .6s var(--e-soft),transform .8s var(--e-soft)}
.roomv.lit .roomv__in{opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:.25s}
.roomv__top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding-bottom:3rem}
.roomv__door{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.5)}
.roomv__head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1.25rem;max-width:44rem;padding-bottom:3.5rem}
.roomv__title{font-size:2.75rem;font-weight:600;line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-.02em}
@media (min-width:640px){.roomv__title{font-size:4rem}}
@media (min-width:1024px){.roomv__title{font-size:4.75rem}}
.roomv__desc{font-size:1.0625rem;line-height:1.55;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.65);max-width:52ch}
.roomv__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:1rem}
@media (min-width:640px){.roomv__grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media (min-width:1024px){.roomv__grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:1.5rem}}
.slot-card{aspect-ratio:4/3;border-radius:var(--radius-card-sm);border:1.5px dashed rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.18);background:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.025);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:.25rem;padding:1.25rem}
.slot-card b{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.4)}
.slot-card span{font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;color:rgba(var(--fg-rgb),.7)}

/* ---------- nav overlay ---------- */
.navm{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:115;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;opacity:0;transition:opacity .45s var(--e-spring)}
.navm.open{opacity:1}
.navm__top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-block:1.25rem}
@media (min-width:640px){.navm__top{padding-block:1.5rem}}
.navm__top .brand svg{color:var(--accent-from)}
.close-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);border-radius:var(--radius-control);padding:.5rem 1rem;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);transition:border-color .25s,color .25s}
.close-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);color:#fff}
.close-btn svg{font-size:.875rem}
.navm__nav{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.navm__nav ul{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.25rem}
.navm__item{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:1rem;width:100%;padding-block:.5rem;text-align:left;font-size:2.25rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;transform:translateY(1rem);opacity:0;transition:all .5s ease-out;transition-delay:var(--d,0ms)}
.navm.open .navm__item{transform:none;opacity:1}
.navm__item small{font-size:1rem;font-weight:400;color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);transition:color .3s}
.navm__item span{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);transition:color .3s}
.navm__item:hover small{color:var(--accent-from)}

<script>
(() => {
  const M = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
  const tick = () => { const d = new Date(), h = d.getHours();
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-ftime]').forEach(e => e.textContent = `${h % 12 || 12}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}${h < 12 ? 'am' : 'pm'}`);
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-fyear]').forEach(e => e.textContent = d.getFullYear()); };
  tick(); setInterval(tick, 20000);
  // size the footer name so it spans the full width with only a sliver of margin
  const fit = () => document.querySelectorAll('.sf').forEach(f => {
    const w = f.querySelector('.sf__word'); if (!w) return;
    const span = [...w.children].find(s => getComputedStyle(s).display !== 'none'); if (!span) return;
    w.style.setProperty('--wf', '100px');
    const k = (f.clientWidth * .955) / span.getBoundingClientRect().width;
    f.style.setProperty('--wf', (100 * k).toFixed(2) + 'px'); w.style.removeProperty('--wf');
  });
  fit(); addEventListener('resize', fit); document.fonts?.ready.then(fit);
  // the footer's rounded corners show whatever sits directly above it: find that section's colour and paint it behind them
  const sfw = document.querySelector('.sfw');
  const above = () => {
    if (!sfw) return;
    const solid = e => { const c = getComputedStyle(e).backgroundColor; const m = c.match(/[\d.]+/g); return m && !(m.length > 3 && +m[3] < .05) ? c : ''; };
    let col = '', e = sfw.previousElementSibling;
    while (e){ if (e.getBoundingClientRect().width >= innerWidth * .9){ const c = solid(e); if (c) col = c; } e = e.lastElementChild; }
    const bg = col || solid(document.body) || getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).backgroundColor;
    sfw.style.setProperty('--above', bg);
    // a dark section above: a hairline keeps the footer reading as its own section
    const m = (bg.match(/[\d.]+/g) || [255, 255, 255]).map(Number);
    sfw.classList.toggle('sfw--dark', (.2126 * m[0] + .7152 * m[1] + .0722 * m[2]) / 255 < .25);
  };
  above(); addEventListener('load', above); addEventListener('resize', above);
  new MutationObserver(above).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-mode'] });
  // floating back-to-top: appears after the first screen, shows scroll progress, flips colour over dark backgrounds
  const tt = document.querySelector('.totop');
  if (tt) {
    const c = tt.querySelector('.ring circle'); tt.style.setProperty('--len', (2 * Math.PI * 24).toFixed(2));
    const lum = el => { for (let e = el; e && e !== document.documentElement; e = e.parentElement) {
        const m = getComputedStyle(e).backgroundColor.match(/[\d.]+/g); if (!m) continue;
        if (m.length > 3 && +m[3] < .5) continue; return (.2126 * m[0] + .7152 * m[1] + .0722 * m[2]) / 255; }
      const m = getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundColor.match(/[\d.]+/g) || [255,255,255];
      return (m.length > 3 && +m[3] < .5) ? (document.documentElement.dataset.mode === 'dark' ? 0 : 1) : (.2126 * m[0] + .7152 * m[1] + .0722 * m[2]) / 255; };
    let raf = 0;
    const upd = () => { raf = 0;
      const max = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight, y = scrollY;
      const bot = document.querySelector('.sf__bot');  // the footer has its own 'Back to top', so step aside once it's on screen
      tt.classList.toggle('show', y > innerHeight * .9 && !(bot && bot.getBoundingClientRect().top < innerHeight - 8));
      tt.style.setProperty('--p', max > 0 ? Math.min(1, y / max).toFixed(4) : 0);
      const r = tt.getBoundingClientRect();
      tt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      const under = document.elementFromPoint(r.left + r.width / 2, r.top + r.height / 2);
      tt.style.pointerEvents = '';
      if (under) tt.dataset.on = lum(under) < .45 ? 'dark' : 'light'; };
    const q = () => { if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(upd); };
    addEventListener('scroll', q, { passive: true }); addEventListener('resize', q);
    new MutationObserver(q).observe(document.documentElement, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-mode', 'class'] });
    upd();
  }
})();

(() => {
  const typing = e => { const t = e.target; return t && (t.isContentEditable || /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(t.tagName)); };
  const toggle = () => {
    const d = document, el = d.documentElement;
    if (d.fullscreenElement || d.webkitFullscreenElement) (d.exitFullscreen || d.webkitExitFullscreen).call(d);
    else (el.requestFullscreen || el.webkitRequestFullscreen)?.call(el)?.catch?.(() => {});
  };
  addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if ((e.key !== 'f' && e.key !== 'F') || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || typing(e)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (window.top !== window) { try { parent.postMessage({ wall: 'fullscreen' }, location.origin === 'null' ? '*' : location.origin); } catch (_) {} return; }
    toggle();
  });
  if (window.top === window) addEventListener('message', e => {
    // only one of this page's own frames can ask for full screen
    if (!e.data || e.data.wall !== 'fullscreen' || ![...document.querySelectorAll('iframe')].some(f => f.contentWindow === e.source)) return;
    toggle();
  });
})();

/* ---------- spring helper (mass 1, semi-implicit Euler) ---------- */
function spring({ tension, friction }, render){
  let x = 0, v = 0, target = 0, raf = 0;
  const step = () => {
    const dt = 1 / 60, a = tension * (target - x) - friction * v;
    v += a * dt; x += v * dt; render(x);
    if (Math.abs(target - x) < 0.001 && Math.abs(v) < 0.001){ x = target; v = 0; render(x); raf = 0; return; }
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  };
  render(0);
  return { set(t){ target = t; if (!raf) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step); } };
}
// declarative hovers: data-h="s 1 1.04|y 0 -2|o .8 1"  data-hs="tension friction"  data-ht="closest trigger"
function bindHovers(scope = document){
  scope.querySelectorAll('[data-h]').forEach(el => {
    if (el._h) return; el._h = 1;
    const props = el.dataset.h.split('|').map(p => { const [k, a, b] = p.trim().split(/\s+/); return { k, a:+a, b:+b }; });
    const [tension, friction] = (el.dataset.hs || '320 18').split(/\s+/).map(Number);
    const trig = el.dataset.ht ? el.closest(el.dataset.ht) || el : el;
    const render = p => {
      const v = { s:1, x:0, y:0, r:0 };
      let o = null;
      props.forEach(({ k, a, b }) => { const val = a + (b - a) * p; if (k === 'o') o = val; else v[k] = val; });
      el.style.transform = `translate(${v.x}px,${v.y}px) rotate(${v.r}deg) scale(${v.s})`;

(function flipCalendar(){

    cal.style.setProperty('--cal-w', wEm.toFixed(3) + 'em');
    const avail = cal.closest('.h1').getBoundingClientRect().width - fs * 0.25;
    const need = wEm * fs;
    if (need > avail) cal.style.fontSize = (fs * avail / need).toFixed(2) + 'px';
    // spiral rings + punched holes, spaced roughly every 0.62em
    const count = Math.max(5, Math.round((wEm - 0.64) / 0.7) + 1);
    rings.innerHTML = '<i></i>'.repeat(count);
    cal.querySelectorAll('.cal__holes').forEach(h => h.innerHTML = '<i></i>'.repeat(count));
  }

  addEventListener('resize', () => { clearTimeout(fit._t); fit._t = setTimeout(fit, 120); });

  function flip(){
    if (document.hidden){ timer = setTimeout(flip, 600); return; }
    flipping = true;
    const next = (i + 1) % n;
    if (reduced){
      i = next; paint(face, i); paint(under, (i + 1) % n);
      flipping = false; timer = setTimeout(flip, HOLD + 700); return;
    }
    const timing = { duration: FLIP, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.5,.05,.2,1)', fill: 'forwards' };
    face.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 1, offset: .285 }, { opacity: 0, offset: .295 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: FLIP, easing: 'linear', fill: 'forwards' });

    $('.cal__shade', under).animate([{ opacity: .7 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: FLIP * .9, easing: 'cubic-bezier(.3,.6,.4,1)', fill: 'forwards' });

      flipping = false;
